# mitnimm — agent API

Switzerland-only map of free sidewalk piles. No auth.

Base: https://mitnimm.onrender.com

- GET /api/agent — discovery card
- GET /api/openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1
- GET /api/categories
- GET /api/spots?category=moebel&q=
- GET /api/nearby?plz=8004&km=3&category=
- GET /api/history?category=

POST /api/spots is for humans on site (GPS + photo). Do not automate posts.

Website: https://mitnimm.onrender.com
Telegram: https://t.me/mitnimmbot
